subject: RE: FW: BRUSSELS AIRPORT - PPT / 104 PCS 5,390 KGS
body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Could you please quote the cheapest air freight option to BOM (Mumbai, IN)? Please arrange truck pickup from our site in 73342 (Esslingen), Germany, and include transport to the departure airport in your all-in price in EUR.

The shipment will be ready for pickup on 2026-11-27. It consists of 11 pieces of cleaning agent, with a gross weight of 1674 kg and a total volume of 4.36 cbm. The packing specification is attached.

Thank you. I look forward to your quote.

Mit freundlichen Gruessen / Kind regards
Jonas Kessler
Logistics Coordinator
Kessler Feinmechanik GmbH, Ulm
